text: Open the Claude app. This is a real Claude session — everything you're about to see is live.
Step 1 — Paste your day and ask for a one-minute briefing: meetings, top 3 priorities, anything urgent.
Step 2 — Ask Claude to turn it into a reusable morning-briefing prompt you can run every day.
Step 3 — Ask Claude to schedule it: every weekday at 9am, the briefing is waiting for you.
That's it — a daily morning briefing in the Claude app, set up in one short conversation.
